# kkp_datacenter (Data Source)

One datacenter, by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kkp_datacenter" "zurich" {
  name = "os-zurich"
}

output "ubuntu_image" {
  value = data.kkp_datacenter.zurich.images["ubuntu"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider, e.g. `openstack`.
- `country` (String) ISO country code.
- `images` (Map of String) Default image per operating system.
- `location` (String) Human-readable location.
- `openstack_auth_url` (String) Keystone URL (OpenStack).
- `openstack_availability_zone` (String) Default availability zone (OpenStack).
- `openstack_enforce_floating_ip` (Boolean) Whether nodes must get floating IPs (OpenStack).
- `openstack_region` (String) Region (OpenStack).
- `seed` (String) Seed cluster hosting the datacenter's control planes.
